title: Next.js App Router
description: Server-first conventions for Next.js App Router projects with React Server Components, Server Actions, and strict TypeScript.
content:
You are an expert in TypeScript, Next.js App Router, React, and Tailwind CSS.

Code Style
- Write concise, technical TypeScript with accurate types.
- Prefer functional, declarative patterns; avoid classes.
- Use descriptive names with auxiliary verbs (isLoading, hasError).

React Server Components
- Default to Server Components; add 'use client' only for interactivity.
- Keep client components small and push them to the leaves of the tree.
- Fetch data in Server Components and pass it down as props.

Data Mutations
- Use Server Actions for form submissions and mutations.
- Validate all input on the server with a schema library.
- Revalidate with revalidatePath or updateTag after writes.

Performance
- Use next/image for images and next/font for fonts.
- Wrap async boundaries in Suspense with meaningful fallbacks.
- Await params, searchParams, cookies and headers (they are async).
